parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Upload a GLB file of the 3D model you want to retexture.

parameters.name: textStylePrompt
parameters.description: Describe your desired texture style using text. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.

parameters.name: imageStyle
parameters.description: Provide a 2D image to guide the texturing process. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.

parameters.name: multiviewImage
parameters.description: Provide 1–4 images of the same object from different views to drive multi-view texturing (Meshy 7). The first image is the primary (front) view. Provide exactly one of Style Prompt, Style Image, or Multi-View Images.
parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value: a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: enablePbr
parameters.description: Generate PBR Maps (metallic, roughness, normal) in addition to the base color.

parameters.name: textureResolution
parameters.description: Base color texture resolution: 2K (2048), 4K (4096), or 8K (8192). At 8K, PBR maps are generated at 4K and no emission map is produced.

parameters.name: enableOriginalUv
parameters.description: Use the model's existing UV map instead of generating a new one. If no UVs are present, output quality may be lower.
